'''2020 TMW Pods Patrick Johnson DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Player:''' [[Patrick Johnson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
